# **Use Case Diagrams and Role Explanations**

### Each project has one general contractor, and the owner chooses the GC type per project. The platform features two combined diagrams: one for a project with a Fixed Contract GC and one for a project with a Daily-Updates GC . Both diagrams show every active stakeholder: Owner, Project Manager, Investor, and CFO. Purple marks the internal team and teal marks external parties.

**Streamlined Functional Scope & Permission Matrix**

Each stakeholder role features a clean architectural diagram and a concise functional scope table user interfaces, actionable controls, and operational decision gates.

**1\. Developer / Owner**

Operational Focus: Evaluates portfolio risk, reviews project control center, uploads bank statements, reconciles amounts, monitors budget vs actuals, tracks debt carry, and certifies draw packages.

**![][image3]**

***Figure 1: Owner / Developer Functional Scope Blueprint***

| Use Case | Target Module & Route | Primary Action Controls | Decision Gate & Operational Logic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| View portfolio dashboard | Portfolio Command Center  | \[+ New Project\], \[Filter by Risk Level\], \[View Cash Gap\], \[Export Portfolio Summary\] | The owner identifies a capital deficit or trade bottleneck across active developments. |
| Review project control center | Project Control Center | \[ToggleTimeline View\], \[Inspect Photos & Evidence\], \[View Cost Breakdown\], \[Simulate Carry Cost\] | Evaluates whether project drift requires trade resequencing or contingency reallocation. |
| Upload bank statements | Banking & Cash Management Hub  | \[Upload Bank PDF / CSV\], \[Connect Plaid / Direct Feed\], \[Select Operating Account\], \[Lock Statement Period\] | The owner directly provides official bank statements as the primary source of cash truth for accounting. |
| Reconcile amounts | Cash Reconciliation Terminal | \[Verify Wire Disbursements\], \[Confirm Loan Proceeds\], \[Approve Matched Invoices (YES)\], \[Flag Discrepancy (NO)\] | Decision Gate: Owner confirms ledger amounts against bank statement deposits and approved draw disbursements. |
| Monitor budget, actual and funded | Budget vs Actuals matrix | \[View Approved Baseline\], \[Track Incurred Spend\], \[Inspect Funded Draws\], \[Export 4-Truths Summary\] | Continuously balances baseline budget, incurred vendor bills, and funded loan wires. |
| Review delay source and carry cost | Schedule Drift & Debt Carry Monitor  | \[Inspect Root Cause\], \[Simulate Daily Interest Carry\], \[Accelerate Trade\], \[Approve Resequencing\] | Evaluates compounding interest carry cost caused by field delays and takes mitigation action. |
| Build draw packet | Draw Package Assembly Hub  | \[Select Draw Billing Period\],\[Auto-Populate Eligible Invoices\], \[Generate AIA G702 / G703 PDF\], \[Submit to Lender Portal\] | Certifies draw application amount for commercial construction lender submission. |
| Act on risk alerts | Executive Risk Notification Center | \[Review Alert Details\], \[Acknowledge Risk\], \[Trigger Contingency Reserve\], \[Assign Corrective Action\] | Responds to automated budget overrun, schedule slippage, or lien waiver risk thresholds. |
| Export investor or partner summary | Capital Partner Portal | \[Generate Executive Preview Link\], \[Review Partner Summary\], \[Set Expiration Date\], \[Export PDF Briefing\] | Authorizes and delivers sanitized progress and financial updates to equity partners. |

**2\.  CFO /Accountant**

Operational Focus: Views bank statements uploaded by owner, creates expense sheets from those statements, uploads finalized sheets, matches expenses to budget, and exports variance reports.

***![][image4]***

***Figure 2: CFO / Accountant***

| Use Case | Target Module & Route | Primary Action Controls | Decision Gate & Operational  Logic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| View bank statements uploaded by owner | Bank Statement Audit Viewer  | \[Select Project Statement\], \[View Deposit Lines\], \[Inspect Wire Outflows\], \[Download Source Document\] | Reviews verified bank statements uploaded by the developer as the authoritative source of cash truth. |
| Build expense sheet in platform | In-Platform Expense Sheet Builder | \[Extract Statement Transactions\], \[Link Lines to Bank Statement Entries\], \[Match Expense to Budget Lines\], \[Save Draft Sheet\] | Builds the project expense sheet directly derived from owner-uploaded bank statements, automatically linking transaction lines to bank entries and matching expenses to baseline budget codes. |
| Upload expense sheet | Expense Ingestion Ledger  | \[Upload Formatted Expense Sheet\], \[Match Expense to Budget Lines\], \[Validate Total Balance\], \[Stage Invoices for Matching\] | Submits pre-formatted expense sheets into the system ledger, executing automated and manual matching against CSI division budget lines. |
| Submit sheet for owner review | Review Submission & Audit Ledger  | \[Validate Balanced Totals\], \[Keep Immutable Edit History\], \[Submit for Owner Sign-Off\], \[Notify Developer\] | Submits a balanced expense sheet for developer approval while automatically preserving an immutable, cryptographic edit history and audit trail. |
| Export variance reports | Financial Variance & Audit Hub  | \[Select Period / Division\], \[Run Pro Forma vs Actual Analysis\], \[Export GAAP Ledger\], \[Generate Board Packet\] | Produces audited budget variance and live Forecast at Completion reports for executive leadership. |

**3\. Project Manager**

Operational Focus: Tracks physical trade completion, manages jurisdictional building inspections, attaches mobile photographic proof, and logs schedule delays.

**![][image5]**

***Figure 3: Project Manager*** 

| Use Case | Target Module & Route | Primary Action Controls | Decision Gate & Operational Logic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Update milestones & progress | Field Milestone Tracker  | \[Log Start Date\], \[Upload Progress Photo\], \[Verify Trade Completion (YES/NO)\], \[Update Physical Completion %\] | Superintendent verifies physical on-site trade completion against Gantt schedule. |
| Log municipal inspections | Municipal Inspection Vault  | \[+ Log Municipal Inspection\], \[Upload Signed Card\], \[Mark Inspection Passed (YES)\], \[Flag Inspection Deficiency (NO)\] | Decision Gate: If Passed \[YES\], unlocks milestones for draw billing; if Failed \[NO\], freezes affected CSI cost code while unaffected trades proceed. |
| Track delay sources | Delay Attribution & Log  | \[Log TradeDelay\], \[Tag Root Cause (Utility/Permit/Weather)\], \[Upload Field Evidence\], \[Calculate CompoundInterest\] | Attaches empirical root-cause evidence to schedule delay days. |

**4 Capital Partner / Investor**

Operational Focus: Monitors invested capital, pro forma returns, schedule health, and upcoming funding events through secure, read-only portal.

**![][image6]**

***Figure 4: Investor & Capital Partner Functional Scope Blueprint***

| Use Case | Target Module & Route | Primary Action Controls | Decision Gate & Operational Logic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| View project health | Capital Partner Dashboard  | \[View Budget Burn Rate\], \[Inspect Physical Completion %\], \[Check Target IRR\], \[Review Milestone Gallery\] | LP gains read-only visibility into capital deployment and construction milestones. |
| See next funding event | Capital Call & Draw Timeline | \[View Projected Draw Dates\], \[Inspect Senior Debt Balance\], \[Track Sales Pace & Absorption\] | Limited Partnership anticipates upcoming bank loan draws and future capital distributions. |
| Receive monthly update | Monthly Executive Briefing  | \[Read Executive Briefing\], \[View Site Progress Gallery\], \[Download Signed Report\] | Reviews developer-certified monthly progress and financial narrative. |

**5\. General Contractor: Fixed Contract Model**

Operational Focus: Submits milestone claims against the agreed Schedule of Values, attaches completion proof, and requests change orders for out-of-scope work.

**![][image7]**

***Figure 5: General Contractor (Fixed Milestone) Functional Scope Blueprint***

| Use Case | Target Module & Route | Primary Action Controls | Decision Gate & OperationalLogic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Submit milestone claim | Milestone Payment Submission Portal | \[Select Completed Milestone\], \[Enter Claim Amount\], \[Attach Sign-Off Proof\], \[Submit Payment Claim\] | Fixed-price GC certifies that milestone scope is complete per contract terms. |
| Upload completion proof | Field Verification Attachment Hub  | \[+ Upload High-Res Photos\], \[Attach Engineer Sign-Off\], \[Attach Municipal Card\], \[Submit Evidence Package\] | Attaches structural certifications and sign-off cards to substantiate billing. |
| Submit change order | Change Order Request Hub | \[+ New Change Order Request\], \[Describe Scope Addition\], \[Attach Cost Breakdown & Photos\], \[Submit for Owner Approval\] | GC submits out-of-scope work requests for owner evaluation. |

**6 General Contractor: Daily-Updates Model (External Open-Book Partner)**

Operational Focus: Submits daily jobsite logs, itemized subcontractor bills, and material receipts with contractor fee transparently separated.

**![][image8]**

***Figure 6: General Contractor (Daily-Updates Open-Book) Functional Scope Blueprint***

| Use Case | Target Module & Route | Primary Action Controls | Decision Gate & Operational Logic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Post daily status update | Daily Site Log Hub | \[+ New Daily Log\], \[Log Trades on Site\], \[Note Jobsite Conditions\], \[Submit Daily Update\] | GC logs daily headcount, weather, and trade activities. |
| Submit invoices, costs & checks | Open-Book Cost Submission Center  | \[+ Upload Subcontractor Invoice\], \[Upload Check / Card Receipt\], \[Batch ZIP Archive Upload\], \[Tag Trade Cost Code\] | Submits itemized subcontractor bills with transparent GC markup. |
| Upload daily site photos | Mobile Photo Stream  | \[+ Take / Upload Mobile Photos\], \[Tag CSI Division\], \[Add Geolocation & Timestamp\], \[Publish to Project Feed\] | Submits continuous timestamped and geotagged field photos. |
| Submit change order request | Open-Book Change Order Hub  | \[+ Propose Scope Change\], \[Itemize Subcontractor Costs\], \[Apply Contractual GC Markup\], \[Submit for Review\] | Request scope changes with itemized subcontractor pass-through and GC fee. |

**7\. Automated System Agent (Background Autonomous Intelligence & Event Bus)**

Operational Focus: Executes autonomous background intelligence: OCR extraction, confidence matching, document validation, event dispatching, and stakeholder notifications.

**![][image9]**

***Figure 7: Automated System Agent Functional Scope Blueprint***

| System Use Case | Target Service & Daemon | System Triggers & Controls | Autonomous Execution & Decision Logic |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Send emails and reminders | Notification Dispatcher  | \[Automated Trigger\], \[Configure Cadence\], \[View Delivery Log\] | Sends automated email reminders for pending approvals, lien waiver submissions, and monthly draw deadlines. |
| Send risk and budget alerts | Risk Monitoring Engine  | \[Threshold Evaluation\], \[Escalate Alert\], \[Notify Leadership\] | Evaluates cost overruns and schedule slips against predefined project risk tolerances. |
| Notify actors of changes | Multi-Actor Event Bus  | \[Broadcast Change Event\], \[Target Role Filter\], \[WebSocket Push\] | Notifies designated stakeholders (Owner, CFO, PM, Investor, GC) of approved change orders, inspection sign-offs, and draw events. |
| Match expenses to budget | AI Ingestion Engine  | \[Run OCR Extraction\], \[Compute Cosine Similarity\], \[Score Confidence\] | Decision Gate: If Match Confidence \>= 0.85 \[YES\], auto-posts to budget line; if Low Confidence (\< 0.85) \[NO\], routes to manual review queue. |
| Reconcile draws vs spend | Ledger Synchronization Bus  | \[Balance Operating Account\], \[Calculate Net Payables\], \[Track Deficit\] | Continuously balances incurred vendor expenses against deposited loan wires to detect cash gaps. |
| Flag missing documents | Compliance Audit  | \[Scan Lien Waivers\], \[Audit Inspection Sign-offs\], \[Enforce Statutory Rules\] | Identifies missing statutory lien waivers (California Civil Code Sections 8132-8138) and unpassed inspections. |
| Update project documents | Document Indexer  | \[Index File\], \[Compute SHA-256 Hash\], \[Detect Duplicates\] | Maintains tamper-proof chain of custody and detects duplicate file uploads across any format or ZIP archive. |
| Generate monthly updated docs | Reporting Synthesis Engine  | \[Compile Forecast\], \[Recalculate FAC\], \[Generate Draft Packet\] | Synthesizes live pro forma forecasts, remaining scope, and compounding debt service into audit-ready statements. |
| Send monthly report | Distribution Engine  | \[Format Briefing\], \[Enforce Privacy Filter\], \[Deliver PDF Package\] | Delivers sanitized executive reports to authorized capital partners without exposing trade-level vendor bills. |
| Route low-confidence items | Exception Routing Engine  | \[Flag Low Confidence (\<0.85)\], \[Route to Human Queue\], \[Hold Ledger Posting\] | Isolates extraction uncertainties from Spend Truth until verified by the human financial controller. |
